notes:
Original and replication assessed independently. Replication is an explicitly stated conceptual replication of Study 2, adapting Canadian-American/Belgian-American high jumping to French-English/Belgian-English judo. The author narrative verdict is paper-level and qualified by generally; it is not inferred from the target p value. Replication text is a frozen parse of publicly accessible author-uploaded full HTML, with title and DOI verified; PDF links were inaccessible. Greek eta is rendered as g in this parse.
Source follow-up: Published version carries copyright 2007 and journal publication 2008, 38:128–138. Primary PDF pages 7–8 rendered and digits verified. Canonical TXT encodes equals as ¼ and multiplication as control glyph.
